summary: Lightweight renewal cartography to surface mid-term risk and micro-plays. Purpose: give CS leads a sprint-friendly view (30/60/90 days) with an immediate set of action items. Uses a simple Risk Score (1 low risk -> 10 high risk) driven by product health, executive engagement, and financial signals. This sheet is intentionally terse to be pasted into QBR decks and ops standups.
heatmap_instructions: Risk Score = (7 - Renewal Probability/15) + Executive-Unrest-Factor + Product-Health-Factor
Executive-Unrest-Factor: 0 if exec engaged, 2 if only manager-level engaged, 4 if escalated
Color buckets for heatmap: 1-3 = green, 4-6 = amber, 7-10 = red
Use Priority column to drive weekly focused outreach; top 8 red accounts go into the escalation cadence
